requirement.reading: Because the endpoint is ~83% accumulated propagation of mid-depth births at near-unity gains, a host reaching 3e-8 must cut the per-layer BIRTH rate by about 2.7x roughly uniformly across layers 3..15; no single-layer fix suffices (S: no layer contributes more than 10.6% of the final MSE). The lambda-cubed shell achieved about 1.11x of this uniformly; the kink carrier must supply the remaining ~2.4x, i.e. represent the pair-structure the lambda shell still linearizes.
requirement.carrier_translation_note: In the original frame the survivor object was a layerwise-local mixed factor/chaos state with up to Q factors in each of 20 Hermite orders. The Phase-2 Q24 host already carries 25 Mehler orders bivariately; its measured birth marker is the quartic residual star (+0.335). The Phase-2 kink-carrier question is therefore: a compressed representation of the star-marked pair structure that the current CP4-plus-pairing decomposition truncates, priced within the roughly 110e9 FLOPs still free under the conditional-repair budget.
